description.en: The 22 mm × 7 mm stator outrunner class used on 5-inch multirotors: an M3 16 × 16 mm base pattern and an M5-threaded prop shaft. It mates an arm or a soft-mount pod by its base and a propeller by its shaft.
description.es: La clase de motor de rotor externo con estator de 22 mm × 7 mm que usan los multirrotores de 5 pulgadas: patrón de base M3 de 16 × 16 mm y flecha de hélice roscada M5. Se une a un brazo o a una base amortiguada por su base y a una hélice por su flecha.
description.fr: La classe de moteur à rotor extérieur à stator de 22 mm × 7 mm des multirotors de 5 pouces : motif de base M3 de 16 × 16 mm et arbre d'hélice fileté M5. Il s'accouple à un bras ou à un support amorti par sa base et à une hélice par son arbre.
description.pt: A classe de motor de rotor externo com estator de 22 mm × 7 mm usada em multirrotores de 5 polegadas: padrão de base M3 de 16 × 16 mm e eixo de hélice roscado M5. Acopla a um braço ou a um suporte amortecido pela base e a uma hélice pelo eixo.

governing.designation: 2207-size brushless outrunner (22 mm stator × 7 mm), 5-inch multirotor class

sources.title: iFlight XING-E Pro 2207 2-6S FPV motor
sources.supports: Ø28.5 × 33.1 mm; 16 × 16 mm mounting with Ø3 mm holes; 5 mm shaft; 13.5 mm shaft protrusion; 33.8 g with wire

sources.title: BrotherHobby Avenger 2207.5 V3 motor
sources.supports: bolt pattern M3 (16 × 16 mm); prop adapter shaft thread M5

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the base (the stator mount face carrying the 16 × 16 mm M3 pattern), on the shaft axis. +z runs along the shaft toward the propeller; +x and +y are parallel to the sides of the 16 mm hole square, so the holes sit at (±8, ±8, 0).

label.es: Altura de asiento de la hélice

parameters.note: Where the propeller hub seats, above the base face. Default derived from the iFlight XING-E Pro 2207: overall height 33.1 − shaft protrusion 13.5 = 19.6 mm. Varies by model; the range is a convention.

interfaces.note: Female: tapped holes receive the fastener's thread.
Male: the shaft enters the propeller hub. Symmetry 0: the propeller's angle on the shaft is free.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P4-STD lane, 2026-10-02); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: A class entry: the base pattern and the M5 prop shaft are the shared facts; bell size, height and mass are those of the cited iFlight motor and vary across the class. The BrotherHobby source is a 2207.5 of the same class.
